name: ryan-minato-skills
description: Curated Agent Skills library, distributed as per-catalog Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Skills recommended for global (user-level) installation: commits, sensitivity, skill authoring, methodology.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: General programming methodology skills and narrow artifact-authoring workflows (e.g. Dev Container artifacts).

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Disposable, project-scoped builders for generic harness machinery: complete agent harness architecture, platform-neutral workflow and agent-authority contracts, git branching contracts, GitHub and GitLab lifecycle workflows, GPU container environments, and Python convention defaults.

plugins.name: scaffold
plugins.description: Disposable, project-scoped builders for a project of a specific topic (machine learning, data science, Colab notebooks). Use whichever topic builder matches the project; the meta catalog's meta-disposal removes it together with the meta builders once the harness is verified.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Human-audience writing: genre skills (academic, blog/opinion, promotional copy) and medium skills (LaTeX, Typst, Markdown source).
